# Big Bang Values Reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-values-reference.sh from chart/Chart.yaml and chart/values.yaml. Do not edit this file directly. -->

![Version: 3.35.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-3.35.0-informational?style=flat-square)  ![Type: application](https://img.shields.io/badge/Type-application-informational?style=flat-square)

Big Bang is a declarative, continuous delivery tool for core DoW hardened and approved packages into a Kubernetes cluster.

This page is generated from [`chart/Chart.yaml`](../../chart/Chart.yaml) and [`chart/values.yaml`](../../chart/values.yaml). Change value documentation in `chart/values.yaml`, then run `scripts/generate-values-reference.sh --write`.

The table contains Big Bang values that have documentation annotations and their defaults for this release. Package-specific passthrough values are defined by the corresponding package chart. The [`values.schema.json`](../../chart/values.schema.json) file is the exhaustive, authoritative validation contract, including union types that YAML defaults cannot express by themselves.

## Requirements

Kubernetes: `>=1.34.0-0`

## Values

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|-----|------|---------|-------------|
| domain | string | `"dev.bigbang.mil"` | Domain used for BigBang created exposed services, can be overridden by individual packages. |
| istio | object | `{"ambient":{"enabled":false},"egressGateway":{"enabled":false}}` | Global Istio settings |
| istio.ambient | object | `{"enabled":false}` | Ambient mesh mode configuration |
| istio.ambient.enabled | bool | `false` | Enable Istio ambient mesh mode. When true, uses ztunnel for mTLS instead of sidecars. This automatically enables istioCNI, ztunnel, and gatewayAPI packages. NOTE: Ambient mode is generally available as of Big Bang 3.32. It remains opt-in in 3.x and becomes the default in 4.0. |
| istio.egressGateway | object | `{"enabled":false}` | Egress gateway configuration |
| istio.egressGateway.enabled | bool | `false` | Enable the shared egress waypoint gateway (requires ambient mode). This automatically enables the istioEgressGateway package. NOTE: The egress gateway is an alpha feature. |
| offline | bool | `false` | Prevent Big Bang from creating GitRepository resources. HelmReleases configured with Git sources will continue to reference those resources, so they must already exist in the expected namespaces. This applies to integrated packages, additional packages, and the package wrapper. |
| helmRepositories | list | `[]` | List of Helm repositories/credentials to pull helm charts from. OCI Type: Must specify username/password or existingSecret if repository requires auth. Using "private-registry" for existingSecret will reuse credentials from registryCredentials above. Default Type: Must specify existingSecret with auth - see https://fluxcd.io/flux/components/source/helmrepositories/#secret-reference for details on secret data required. |
| registryCredentials | object, list, or null | `nil` | Registry credentials used to pull all images deployed by Big Bang. Set to null (or omit) if your environment provides ambient image pull access, e.g. AWS EKS nodes with an IAM role granting ECR access, or GKE Workload Identity for GCR. When null, no private-registry Secret or imagePullSecrets stanzas are created. registryCredentials.username is required to be non-null if registryCredentials is defined registryCredentials.password is required to be non-null if registryCredentials is defined registryCredentials.registry will default to registry1.dso.mil registryCredentials.email will default to "" |
| openshift | bool | `false` | OpenShift Container Platform feature toggle. |
| git | object | `{"credentials":{"caFile":"","knownHosts":"","password":"","privateKey":"","publicKey":"","username":""},"existingSecret":""}` | Git credential settings for accessing private repositories Order of precedence is:   1. existingSecret   2. http credentials (username/password/caFile)   3. ssh credentials (privateKey/publicKey/knownHosts) |

| packages.mimir.kafkaIngestStorage.brokerPort | int | `9092` | Kafka broker port. Use 9092 for plaintext, 9093 for TLS. For auth (SASL, IAM) or TLS client config, use values.upstream.mimir.structuredConfig.ingest_storage.kafka directly. |
